findings.message: At k=5, x0=0, the marker's guide lines (guide.marker.x and guide.marker.y) are missing from the frame. The default, gentle and shifted captures all show them. This inconsistency is probably tied to the marker sitting near the top of the plot. The marker's readout link is therefore not drawn in this state.
At x0=-3, the marker guide lines are missing from the frame, although the marker is on the curve at y=0.982. The other captures draw them, and the marker is the point the readouts refer to.

The values are correct (y=0.993307, slope=0.03324). However, the 'Most steep' state makes the tangent slope at the marker smaller than in the default state (0.0332 versus 0.1966). This could mislead a learner into reading steepness as sensitivity everywhere. The card gives no explanation that the slope is measured at the marker, which lies far from the midpoint.

The frames list no drawn tangent line object or legend object, only a plot with a 'Tangent' series. I can't judge from the frames whether the tangent is drawn correctly. The marker label placement and guide ends (y=274) also can't be checked without pixels.
